item.title: Moving data off a legacy platform without a big bang
item.description: Moving code from a legacy platform to new services is the part everyone talks about. With the gateway in front, you can route one endpoint at a time to the new service. Moving the data is harder, because for a while it has to live in two places, and both places think they’re right. The “big bang” version: announce downtime for a weekend, stop everything, run a migration script, switch, hope.
